title: Account
subtitle: 「帳戶／帳號」，究竟是怎樣的 account？
description: 「帳戶／帳號」，究竟是怎樣的 account？

words.note: 最直接、最中性的數碼服務用語，表示某位使用者在系統中的登入及使用身份。
words.example: Each employee must create a separate user account.
words.exampleZh: 每名員工都必須建立獨立的使用者帳戶。

exercises.original: Each employee needs a separate account to access the internal system.

options.explanation: 最直接表示系統中的個別使用身份。

exercises.original: Administrators can suspend a user's account if they detect suspicious activity.

options.explanation: suspend account 是標準系統管理語境。

words.note: 表示在網站、應用程式或網上服務中使用的帳戶。
words.example: You can manage your bookings through your online account.
words.exampleZh: 你可以透過網上帳戶管理預訂。

exercises.original: You can manage your bookings through your account on the website.

options.explanation: 明確表示網站上的帳戶。

exercises.original: Customers can view past invoices in their account online.

options.explanation: 適合描述網上服務中的客戶帳戶。

words.meaning: 使用者個人檔案；個人資料頁
words.note: 表示帳戶中展示或儲存的個人資料、偏好、照片、簡介等。
words.example: You can add a photo and biography to your user profile.
words.exampleZh: 你可以在使用者個人檔案中加入照片和簡介。

exercises.original: You can add your photo, job title, and biography to your account page.

options.explanation: 照片、職位、簡介都是個人檔案內容。

exercises.original: The app lets users choose whether their account information is public or private.

options.explanation: public/private 常用於可見的個人資料。

words.note: 較簡短、常見，表示某人在平台上的個人資料頁或身份展示。
words.example: Her profile lists her current role and contact information.
words.exampleZh: 她的個人檔案列出目前職位和聯絡資料。

exercises.original: Her account page shows her current role and contact information.
Recruiters often look at a candidate's account page before an interview.

options.explanation: 招聘者查看的是個人資料頁。

words.note: 在部分日常技術語境中，可指一組用來登入系統的身份，尤其強調登入這個動作或登入名稱。
words.example: IT created a separate login for the new contractor.
words.exampleZh: 資訊科技部門為新承辦商建立了獨立登入帳號。

exercises.original: IT created a temporary account for the contractor so he could access one system.
Each test environment uses a different account for access.

options.explanation: 強調進入不同系統的登入身份。

words.note: 常見於產品介面和支援文件，表示使用者進入服務時使用的登入身份或登入機制。
words.example: Your sign-in is linked to your work email address.
words.exampleZh: 你的登入身份與工作電郵地址連結。

exercises.original: Your account login is linked to your work email address.

options.explanation: 強調登入身份或登入方式。

exercises.original: You can change the account method from password to passkey.

options.explanation: sign-in method 是自然技術搭配。

words.note: 表示某人屬於某個俱樂部、平台、組織或服務的會員身份與資格。
words.example: Your membership gives you access to premium resources.
words.exampleZh: 你的會員資格讓你可以使用進階資源。

exercises.original: Your account gives you access to members-only events until December.

options.explanation: 重點是會員資格與會員權益。

exercises.original: The club will renew your account automatically each year.

words.meaning: 訂閱帳戶；訂閱服務關係
words.note: 表示使用者對某項持續服務的付費或訂閱關係。
words.example: You can cancel your subscription at the end of the billing period.
words.exampleZh: 你可以在計費週期結束時取消訂閱。

exercises.original: You can cancel your paid account at the end of the billing period.

options.explanation: billing period 明確指向付費訂閱關係。

exercises.original: The account includes access to premium articles for one year.

options.explanation: 有明確期間與進階內容存取權。

words.note: 表示某家公司為客戶建立的帳戶，通常與訂單、付款、服務記錄或客戶資料有關。
words.example: The refund will appear in your customer account within two business days.
words.exampleZh: 退款會在兩個工作天內顯示於你的客戶帳戶。

exercises.original: The refund will appear in your account within two business days.

options.explanation: 涉及公司與客戶的付款與服務記錄。

exercises.original: Customers can update their shipping addresses in their accounts.

options.explanation: 電商／服務公司語境很自然。

words.meaning: 客戶帳戶；客戶專用帳戶
words.note: 常見於專業服務、代理、金融或企業系統，表示某位客戶或客戶公司的專屬帳戶。
words.example: Each client account has its own billing history and documents.
words.exampleZh: 每個客戶帳戶都有自己的計費記錄和文件。

exercises.original: Each consulting customer has a separate account containing contracts and invoices.

options.explanation: 專業服務中客戶專屬帳戶很自然。

exercises.original: The agency stores campaign files separately for every customer's account.

options.explanation: 代理／顧問服務語境自然。

words.note: 表示某個會員在服務或組織中的登入帳戶，兼具會員身份 + 系統帳戶意味。
words.example: Members can update their contact details through their member accounts.
words.exampleZh: 會員可以透過會員帳戶更新聯絡資料。

exercises.original: Members can update their contact details through their accounts.

options.explanation: 同時包含會員身份與登入帳戶。

exercises.original: The association created an account for every registered member.

words.meaning: 工作空間；團隊帳戶空間
words.note: 在協作軟件中，表示某個人或團隊使用的共同工作環境，包含文件、成員、設定等。
words.example: She was invited to the company's shared workspace.
words.exampleZh: 她獲邀加入公司的共享工作空間。

exercises.original: She was invited to the company's shared account area where the whole team stores documents.

options.explanation: 強調多人共同使用的工作環境。

exercises.original: One user account can belong to several team accounts.

options.explanation: 一個 account 可加入多個團隊空間。

words.note: 較技術化，表示系統用來識別某位使用者的身份實體。
words.example: The system verifies the user's identity before granting access.
words.exampleZh: 系統會在授予存取權前驗證使用者身份。

exercises.original: The system verifies your account identity before granting access to sensitive data.

options.explanation: 安全系統驗證的是使用者身份。

exercises.original: Each employee's digital account identity is managed centrally.

options.explanation: 適合企業身份管理語境。

words.note: 表示用來證明身份並登入的帳號密碼、金鑰、憑證或其他驗證資料。
words.example: Never share your login credentials with anyone.
words.exampleZh: 不要與任何人分享你的登入憑證。

exercises.original: Never share your account details such as your password or security key.

options.explanation: 密碼、金鑰等都是驗證憑證。

exercises.original: If your account login information has been exposed, reset it immediately.

options.explanation: 指用來登入和驗證身份的資料。

falseSynonyms.zh: profile 通常只是 account 中的個人資料部分。 刪除 profile picture 不等於刪除 account。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I changed my profile picture. I deleted my account.

falseSynonyms.zh: 密碼只是登入帳戶所使用的一項驗證資料。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I forgot my password. My account is still active.

falseSynonyms.zh: username 是識別或登入名稱；account 是完整的使用身份。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Your username is edmund88. Your account contains your settings and history.

falseSynonyms.zh: login 更集中於登入身份或登入過程。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON IT created a login for temporary access. The full account includes storage, settings, and permissions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 會員資格是服務關係；帳戶是系統身份。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Your membership expires next month. Your account will remain accessible until then.

falseSynonyms.zh: 你可以有 account，但沒有付費 subscription。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I created a free account. I later added a paid subscription.

falseSynonyms.zh: credentials 是登入 account 所需的驗證資料。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Reset your credentials if you think they were exposed. Your account itself does not need to be deleted.

falseSynonyms.zh: 一個 account 可以加入多個 workspace。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I use one account. That account belongs to three different workspaces.
